title: Acute Zorg IG NL
registry-description: Dutch Acute Zorg (acute care) exchanges, built on nl-core. First use case: ambulance to GP out-of-hours service referral
introduction: Information exchange in acute care in the Netherlands (Acute Zorg), built on nl-core. The first use case is the referral from the ambulance service to the GP out-of-hours service (AMB to HAP).
